comments.text: The heightened fight-or-flight response in women may also be due to a far more perilous existence for most of human history. There is a very interesting theory about how human women have numerous adaptations found in prey animals. A heightened threat response, wider peripheral vision with increased motion detection, the tendency to travel in groups and react disproportionately cautious to the mere possibility of danger, etc. A woman avoids situations with strange men for the same reason a horse spooks: the ones who didn't tend to get killed...
